title: Register with CalSavers or certify a retirement plan exemption
authority: CalSavers Retirement Savings Program (California State Treasurer)
description: Employers with at least one W-2 employee that do not offer a qualified plan must register and enroll eligible employees, or certify an exemption. The 1 to 4 employee deadline was December 31, 2025; a secondary source says employers that first have an employee in 2026 have until December 31, 2026. Penalty reported as $250 per eligible employee after 90 days of noncompliance, and another $500 after 180 days.

appliesWhen.description: Does not sponsor a qualified retirement plan

exemptions: Employers that sponsor a qualified retirement plan (they still certify the exemption)

title: Train supervisors and employees on sexual harassment prevention
description: Employers with five or more employees must give supervisors two hours and other employees one hour of harassment prevention training every two years, and to new hires within six months of hire or promotion to supervisor (Government Code 12950.1).

appliesWhen.description: 5 or more employees in the state
